title: Shade
wikitext:
{{Stub}}[[image:Shade.png|thumb|]]
A disembodied spirit and a type of [[ghost]]. These often restless spirits are mostly found in the [[Plaguelands]], other [[undead]]-infested areas, and the village surrounding the mysterious tower of [[Karazhan]]. Because of they do not have a real body, some shades are immune to physical damage.

Due to their invisibility, shades are employed by the [[Scourge]] as spies and scouts. They are created from the sacrifice of [[acolyte]]s of the [[Cult of the Damned]]
